Who We Work With

Three ways in.

For Students

Build real experience.

Learn to think and solve problems like a consultant, and acquire skills that translate to any industry you pursue. Our curriculum teaches you to problem solve and present findings to a real client.

How to join›

For Nonprofits

Strategy at no cost.

Your organization receives pro bono consulting from a team of UT Austin students. We work closely with you across an 8–10 week engagement to deliver solutions you can act on.

Our services›

For Sponsors & Alumni

Stay connected.

Support the next generation of purpose-driven consultants. Mentor students, speak at events, or sponsor a semester of pro bono work in Austin.
